mira.design: Quick sync - prototyped a tiny quickstart toolbar that docks to the bottom of the workspace as an alternative to the modal walkthrough. Preview on staging: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/toolbar-vs-modal :mag_right:
noah_research: Lab sessions suggested toolbars feel less interruptive than full-screen modals. Users liked seeing the editor while they follow steps.
tess_writer: Copy question: toolbar CTA text should be ultra-short. Options: 'Run sample', 'Create API key', 'Quickstart'. Any preference?
lee_frontend: From an implementation POV toolbar is easier to keep out of focus order than modal, but we must ensure it's reachable by keyboard and doesn't trap focus.
sam_access: Accessibility notes: 1) toolbar must not use color alone; 2) each toolbar step must be a real <button> with aria-label and aria-describedby linking to details; 3) ensure toolbar is hidden from assistive tech when collapsed (aria-hidden) and revealed properly when expanded.
devon_devex: Analytics: onboard.toolbar_open, onboard.modal_open, onboard.toolbar_cta_click, onboard.api_key_created. Include variant, user_id, elapsed_ms. We'll need consistent naming to compare.
mira.design: UX hypothesis: toolbar increases visibility without breaking flow; modal might have higher completion for less technical users because it forces attention. We'll A/B test.
lee_frontend: Small dev note: toolbar animation caused layout shift on small widths. I'll implement transform-based animations to avoid reflow.
sam_access: Also: for screen reader users prefer modal semantics for tight step-by-step tours (role=dialog), but if toolbar is used add a skip control and a clear focus management plan.	ess_writer: For toolbar microcopy: how about 'Run sample' for primary CTA and 'Create key' as inline secondary? Keep verbs first.
noah_research: In prototypes we saw 'Run sample' had higher click intent. Users understand 'sample' better than 'quickstart'.
mira.design: Good. We'll go with 'Run sample' primary, 'Create key' secondary. I'll update mocks and add SR-only explanatory text: 'Opens sample in workspace' etc.
devon_devex: For the experiment, split new users 50/50 toolbar vs modal. Track api-key creation, time-to-first-call, sample-open, and 7-day retention. We'll capture variant in every event.
lee_frontend: Accessibility implementation plan: toolbar toggles to an expanded panel, focus moves to first action, collapsing returns focus to the toggle. No trapping. Will avoid tabindex fiddling.
sam_access: Ensure prefers-reduced-motion respected and add an aria-live region to announce step changes. Also provide visible focus ring (4px) for keyboard users.
mira.design: One more UX detail: toolbar shows progress 'Step 1 of 3' which helped users in tests. But keep it small to avoid clutter.
noah_research: Minor: show a micro-preview of the sample when hovering/expanding to reduce surprise. But make it lightweight (thumbnail + 1-line).
lee_frontend: Will lazy-load preview assets and show skeletons to avoid jank. Also will ensure the toolbar doesn't cover critical form controls on smaller viewports.
devon_devex: I'll add instrumentation hooks for funnel analysis and the experiment dashboard.
deploy-bot: New staging deploy: onboard/toolbar-vs-modal @ 2025-09-11T20:42:01Z :rocket:
mira.design: Thanks team. Please review the PR for copy + a11y before we ship the experiment. If keyboard/a11y issues persist we default to modal. :thumbsup:
